original_six_tests: Same six fake-data CLI cases and assertions as v1. One harness line observes o.safe_invoke instead of helper.invoke. Actual pack/restore children still use /usr/bin/python3 for both controller suites.
five_added_mock_tests: Started-receipt OSError: old invoke wait=0/no exit receipt; new invoke wait=1/confirmed reaped/real exit 0 recorded while operation still fails.
First wait OSError then second wait 0: two waits, no poll, confirmed reaped, original failure propagated rather than passing.
Two wait errors then poll=None: exactly two waits/one poll, no kill/terminate, SUMMARY local_workers=null/unresolved PID, second batch never starts.
Normal exit 0 succeeds and nonzero exit 7 fails; both one wait and retained actual exit.
KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit during first wait: second wait reaps before original interruption propagates; no kill/terminate.
closure_boundary: Two blocking waits and one final poll are finite recovery attempts, not a guarantee against persistently broken wait, SIGKILL, power loss or interpreter failure. Unconfirmed child closure is explicitly unknown, retained with PID and never reported as local_workers=0 or passed. Total disk failure may prevent receipts; missing receipts never imply completion.
